text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. ambassador in Rabat Marc Ginsberg reiterates his country's support to Morocco.
- Supreme court moves to newly-built headquarters.
- Algerian Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia meets energy mimisters of Morocco, Spain and Portugal at inauguration of Maghreb gas pipeline running from Algeria to Spain.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri says worst waste in towns to be removed before end of December.
- Tax directorate releases circular on fiscal measures to be applied within 1996-97 finance law.
- Euro-Maghreb gas pipeline is the backbone of Maghreb Arab Union.
- Polisario Front says contacts continuing with Morocco over referendum in disputed Western Sahara.
